name: icon-morph
title: Icon morph engine
description: Dependency-free true path morphing between arbitrary stroke icons: flattens any rendered SVG into contours, keeps shared strokes still, carves strokes cut by a slash out of the original, pairs the rest by position and length with a rotation-aware blend, and draws leftovers in or out.

name: icon-swap
title: IconSwap
description: Swaps any two icons (lucide-react or youj) with rotate, scale-blur, draw, flip, slide, fold, wipe, zoom, pop or a true morph. One progress value drives every transition, so reversing mid-swap never jumps; per-state labels; instant under reduced motion.

name: use-icon-state
title: useIconState
description: Turns an IconSwap or a state icon into an accessible toggle button: aria-pressed with a fixed name for toggles, or a name that follows the state for actions like play/pause.
